CeraVe also have formulas that contain beneficial skincare ingredients like moisture-retaining hyaluronic acid, calming niacinamide, and peptides to improve the look of tired skin. 




Beneficial to every skin type, from dry, oily, acne-prone, and combination skin to specific skin concerns such as rough and bumpy skin, eczema, and psoriasis, we have a product right for you that will elevate your skin routine. 




Suggested Use

Apply liberally as often as needed, or as directed by a physician.

__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Q: What is the product’s expiry date?

A: Except for some products that do not have an expiration date from the manufacturer. However, all products are fresh and stored in a cold environment for at least min. 1 year shelf-life. Please contact our customer service team for the exact date.




Q: The products sold in the shop are authentic?

A: Yes, we guarantee that all products sold in our shop are 100% original and genuine. For more information concerning the authenticity of our product, please contact the respective brands for further clarification.




Q: How long will it take for me to receive the product?

A: Once you place an order, estimate it will take no later than 2 working days of packing exclude Saturday, Sunday, and Holidays and Ninja Van will attempt delivery at the delivery address stated in the shipping label within 1 to 3 working days for standard delivery anytime between 9am-10pm every day, with the exception of Sundays and Public Holidays. 




Q: Are there any physical stores in Singapore? Do you offer self-pickup?

A: We have a warehouse in Singapore. Please contact our team if you would like to arrange self-pickup.



Q: The product seal is broken or the box is dented.

A: Some CeraVe products have weak sticker seals. There is a protective seal on the Moisturizing cream product only in the US version 539g, the rest does not come with one. 



Before delivering the product to the customer, we will wrap it in bubble wrap or boxed it in carton to protect it. 



If you have any concerns, please contact CeraVe Official Facebook and usually it takes 1-2 days to respond 

https://www.facebook.com/CeraVe/




Please contact our team if you need further assistance.

aiTexts: CeraVe Hydrating Foaming Cleanser is a cream lotion serum designed to moisturize and restore your skin barrier.
Skin Types: Suitable for normal to dry skin, including sensitive and acne-prone skin.
Skin Concerns: Addresses rough, bumpy skin, eczema, and psoriasis.
Key Ingredients: Formulated with ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and retinol for deep hydration and barrier repair.
Usage: Apply liberally as needed, or as directed by a physician.
Additional Features: Non-comedogenic, non-irritating, and accepted by the National Eczema Association.
aiDescription.aiTip: AI-generated content for reference purposes only.

product.desc:
- 100% Authentic Products Only 

- Imported from U.S. / Australia



CeraVe skincare products were developed with dermatologists and are formulated with three essential ceramides to help restore and maintain your skin barrier, thereby helping to lock in moisture and protect against irritants. 




CeraVe also have formulas that contain beneficial skincare ingredients like moisture-retaining hyaluronic acid, calming niacinamide, and peptides to improve the look of tired skin. 




Beneficial to every skin type, from dry, oily, acne-prone, and combination skin to specific skin concerns such as rough and bumpy skin, eczema, and psoriasis, we have a product right for you that will elevate your skin routine. 




Suggested Use

Apply liberally as often as needed, or as directed by a physician.

__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Q: What is the product’s expiry date?

A: Except for some products that do not have an expiration date from the manufacturer. However, all products are fresh and stored in a cold environment for at least min. 1 year shelf-life. Please contact our customer service team for the exact date.




Q: The products sold in the shop are authentic?

A: Yes, we guarantee that all products sold in our shop are 100% original and genuine. For more information concerning the authenticity of our product, please contact the respective brands for further clarification.




Q: How long will it take for me to receive the product?

A: Once you place an order, estimate it will take no later than 2 working days of packing exclude Saturday, Sunday, and Holidays and Ninja Van will attempt delivery at the delivery address stated in the shipping label within 1 to 3 working days for standard delivery anytime between 9am-10pm every day, with the exception of Sundays and Public Holidays. 




Q: Are there any physical stores in Singapore? Do you offer self-pickup?

A: We have a warehouse in Singapore. Please contact our team if you would like to arrange self-pickup.



Q: The product seal is broken or the box is dented.

A: Some CeraVe products have weak sticker seals. There is a protective seal on the Moisturizing cream product only in the US version 539g, the rest does not come with one. 



Before delivering the product to the customer, we will wrap it in bubble wrap or boxed it in carton to protect it. 



If you have any concerns, please contact CeraVe Official Facebook and usually it takes 1-2 days to respond 

https://www.facebook.com/CeraVe/




Please contact our team if you need further assistance.

3270619664.title: [Clearance] RoseBaie Biotin and Collagen Shampoo 500ml (For Brittle, Sparse Hair: Hair Loss & Hair Strengthening)
3270619664.detail_text: A powerful anti-hair loss shampoo formulated with biotin and collagen to strengthen hair, activate growth, and reduce hair fall. - Infused with biotin (vitamin B7) to fortify hair follicles, stimulate growth, and prevent hair loss. - Enriched with collagen to boost elasticity, nourish hair strands, and minimize breakage. - Promotes a fuller, stronger hair while providing essential structural support. - Suitable for all types of hair loss, for both women and men. Key Ingredients: 1)Biotin: Also known as vitamin B7. It helps to strengthen hair, promote growth, and prevent hair loss by boosting keratin production, leading to a fuller, more vibrant hair. 2)Collagen: Boosts hair elasticity and strength, preventing breakage and nourishing follicles, resulting in silkier, more resilient hair. How to use: 1.Apply on damp hair, gently massage, then thoroughly rinse. Repeat. 2.Can be used in addition to the Biotin & Collagen mask. Full Ingredients: Aqua (Water), Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Cocoamphoacetate, Coco-glucoside, Glycerin, Betaine, Lecithin, Hydrolyzed Collagen, Biotin, Parfum (Fragrance), Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Cocamide Mea, Polyquaternium-7, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzoic Acid, Dehydroacetic Acid, Tocopherol, Disodium Edta.

3012701560.title: (BLANC DUBU) 112526 Groom Maison De Body Lotion 500ml - COCOMO
3012701560.detail_text: Name: Blanc Dubu 112526 Groom Maison de Body Lotion Volume: 500ml Made in: South Korea Product Description: Groom's 112526 Maison De Body Lotion is a highly moisturizing and gentle formula suitable for the whole family. It is absorbed quickly without stickiness, forming a moisturizing foam on the skin and keeping dry skin moisturized all day. This lotion is formulated without any ingredients of concern such as parabens, artificial coloring, or mineral oil, ensuring safe body care. The lotion contains 24.5% dragon's blood resin extract (Croton lechleri), known for being 50 times more effective than vitamin E and 20 times more effective than vitamin C, helping to improve weak and tired skin. Enriched with high-quality raw materials suitable for the face, including liposomal amino acids, ceramide, and collagen; the lotion moisturizes the skin and helps improve dryness. Adding Bio VitaDerm, which includes vitamin C, E, ceramide, and probiotics, enhances the skin penetration of active ingredients, providing a luxurious moisturizing experience. The Ultra Moist P3 complex (okra fruit, molochia leaf, and parsley), helps moisturize the skin and supply ample vitamins and minerals. The lotion is finished with Groom's signature fragrance, of marine sandalwood that is subtle and yet long-lasting! Frequency and Direction of Use: Apply the Groom's Body Lotion for your body or even face to deep moisturize your skin without any stickiness. This lotion is formulated with good ingredients, ensuring safe and effective body care for the whole family. The lotion can be applied on cleansed and dried skin whenever needed throughout the day. Incorporate the Groom’s Body Cleanser into your daily routine along with the Cloud Lotion for smooth, moisturized skin that lasts all day. 3482650939.title: DermaVeen Intensive Moisturising Lotion 1.25L Extra Hydration for Extra Dry, Itchy & Sensitive Skin
3482650939.detail_text: DermaVeen Extra Hydration Intensive Moisturising Lotion for extra dry, itchy & sensitive skin. Dermatologically tested, deeply nourishes, non-greasy, locks in moisture and with colloidal oatmeal that soothes & restores skin. DermaVeen is not only free from common irritants; it is formulated with 100% natural finely milled oat from the Avena Sativa plant - known as Colloidal Oatmeal. Offering a host of dermatological benefits, Colloidal Oatmeal is scientifically proven to help hydrate, fight dryness, restore the protective barrier and soothe skin prone to itch & irritation. DermaVeen Extra Hydration Intensive Moisturising Lotion is fortified with extra Colloidal Oatmeal to lock in moisture & intensely nourish extra dry & sensitive skin. This rich lotion forms a protective moisture layer, while deeply replenishing the skin to restore resilience & smoothness.

1710531403.detail_html:
Organist Natural Hair Healing Therapy Shampoo 500ml x 2

[Product Description]

1. Contains natural cleansers

■ Potassium Olivate obtained from olive oil acts as a natural cleanser

2. Low pH level

■ Helps to maintain the oil moisture balance of scalp and acidity level of healthy hair and skin

3. Organic eco botanic essence

■ Maintains sebum balance. Contains essences of the plant ingredients grown without synthetic pesticides and artificial fertilizers

4. Without 20 harmful additives, such as

■ Silicon, paraben, petroleum-based surfactants, animal oil, mineral oil, triclosan, triclocarban, benzalkonium chloride and benzophenone-3, benzophenone-4

1. Rosemary and Sea Salt Scalp Deep Cleansing Shampoo 500ml

■ Deep cleansing of dead skin cells and sebum with refreshing rosemary, mineral-rich sea salt

2. Himalaya Pink Salt Shampoo 500ml

■ Deep cleanses with mineral-rich Himalayan Pink Salt

■ Helps maintain excess sebum balance with moist minerals

■ Lightly scented

■ Contains with rich minerals of the primordial sea and dozens of minerals

3. Peppermint and Ginger Cooling Shampoo 500ml

■ A refreshing dandruff cooling care for stuffy scalp that contains fresh peppermint, ginger

■ Good for skin, health, and panthenol effects (for moisturizing and calming)

■ Helps to maintain the oil moisture balance of scalp and hair

4. Avocado & Quinoa Hair Root Nutrition Shampoo/Conditioner 500ml

■ Root strengthening and nourishment for thin, weak hair

■ Achieving strong and resilient hair with protein-rich quinoa and vitamin-rich avocado

■ Enhance thin powerless hair with this vitamin-rich avocado, protein-rich quinoa and biotin

5. Cherry Blossom Moisture Shampoo/Conditioner 500ml

■ Hydrating dry and frizzy hair with Cherry Blossom and Hyaluronic Acid

■ A hydrating care for lifeless and thinning hair, containing deep moisturizing capabilities and is filled with vitamins for the hair

■ Suitable for damaged hair as this shampoo fills the cuticle gap and prevent nutrient loss

6. Morocco Argan Oil Gloss Nutrition Shampoo/Conditioner 500ml

■ Repairing and nourishing damaged, tangled hair.

■ Attaining smooth and silky hair with deep-nourishing argan oil and scalp protecting ceramides

■ Intensive care for overworked hair due to frequent chemical treatments like perms and dyeing

■ Treat frizzy and brittle hair with Morocco Argan Oil Repairing Shampoo for smooth and radiant hair

■ Suitable for damaged hair as this shampoo fills the cuticle gap and prevent nutrient loss

■ Containing nature loving and Eco friendly ingredients like fermented vinegar from natural herbs and natural argan oil

How to use:

Shampoo: Take appropriate amount and lather before applying the shampoo onto wet hair. Massage and rinse the hair thoroughly with water and follow up with Organist conditioner.

Conditioner:

After shampooing, apply a small amount evenly on wet hair. Gently massage into hair and rinse thoroughly with water after 1 minute.

Please refer to our website for full ingredients list.

product.desc:
Organist Natural Hair Healing Therapy Shampoo 500ml x 2

[Product Description]

1. Contains natural cleansers

■ Potassium Olivate obtained from olive oil acts as a natural cleanser

2. Low pH level

■ Helps to maintain the oil moisture balance of scalp and acidity level of healthy hair and skin

3. Organic eco botanic essence

■ Maintains sebum balance. Contains essences of the plant ingredients grown without synthetic pesticides and artificial fertilizers

4. Without 20 harmful additives, such as

■ Silicon, paraben, petroleum-based surfactants, animal oil, mineral oil, triclosan, triclocarban, benzalkonium chloride and benzophenone-3, benzophenone-4

1. Rosemary and Sea Salt Scalp Deep Cleansing Shampoo 500ml

■ Deep cleansing of dead skin cells and sebum with refreshing rosemary, mineral-rich sea salt

2. Himalaya Pink Salt Shampoo 500ml

■ Deep cleanses with mineral-rich Himalayan Pink Salt

■ Helps maintain excess sebum balance with moist minerals

■ Lightly scented

■ Contains with rich minerals of the primordial sea and dozens of minerals

3. Peppermint and Ginger Cooling Shampoo 500ml

■ A refreshing dandruff cooling care for stuffy scalp that contains fresh peppermint, ginger

■ Good for skin, health, and panthenol effects (for moisturizing and calming)

■ Helps to maintain the oil moisture balance of scalp and hair

4. Avocado & Quinoa Hair Root Nutrition Shampoo/Conditioner 500ml

■ Root strengthening and nourishment for thin, weak hair

■ Achieving strong and resilient hair with protein-rich quinoa and vitamin-rich avocado

■ Enhance thin powerless hair with this vitamin-rich avocado, protein-rich quinoa and biotin

5. Cherry Blossom Moisture Shampoo/Conditioner 500ml

■ Hydrating dry and frizzy hair with Cherry Blossom and Hyaluronic Acid

■ A hydrating care for lifeless and thinning hair, containing deep moisturizing capabilities and is filled with vitamins for the hair

■ Suitable for damaged hair as this shampoo fills the cuticle gap and prevent nutrient loss

6. Morocco Argan Oil Gloss Nutrition Shampoo/Conditioner 500ml

■ Repairing and nourishing damaged, tangled hair.

■ Attaining smooth and silky hair with deep-nourishing argan oil and scalp protecting ceramides

■ Intensive care for overworked hair due to frequent chemical treatments like perms and dyeing

■ Treat frizzy and brittle hair with Morocco Argan Oil Repairing Shampoo for smooth and radiant hair

■ Suitable for damaged hair as this shampoo fills the cuticle gap and prevent nutrient loss

■ Containing nature loving and Eco friendly ingredients like fermented vinegar from natural herbs and natural argan oil

How to use:

Shampoo: Take appropriate amount and lather before applying the shampoo onto wet hair. Massage and rinse the hair thoroughly with water and follow up with Organist conditioner.

Conditioner:

After shampooing, apply a small amount evenly on wet hair. Gently massage into hair and rinse thoroughly with water after 1 minute.

Please refer to our website for full ingredients list.
